Name: Hushai the Archite
Summary: Hushai the Archite, David's friend, stayed in Jerusalem when David fled and pretended to serve Absalom. His counsel — to wait and gather all Israel — overruled Ahithophel's plan for a swift strike and saved David's life and kingdom.
KeyStory: Hushai's slow counsel defeated Ahithophel's swift counsel and saved David.
RelatedPeople: King David; Absalom; Ahithophel the Gilonite; Zadok, Son of Ahitub
LifeLesson: One loyal friend inside the enemy's council can be worth an army.
